remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive  in 1969 indicates, "Seen by me in Abiquiú, 12/1969. See notes. (Was I wrong about the date and the order in the series!)". Part of series inspired by Colorado River trips from 1964 to 1967. Backing inscription dates 1964. Whitney Archive and Abiquiú Notebooks date 1967. Dated ca. 1965 on basis of inclusion in 1967 New York (Whitney – Annual) exhibition. See cat. nos. 1499–1501, 1539–54, 1577, 2021–24. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks, Whitney Archive in 1969.
titles.title: Canyon No. II

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Two cliffs slope towards each other and form a v-shape in the center of the canvas.  The hill on the left has a steep slant, while the slant of the hill on the right curves a bit more.  Two lighter-colored bands with a central v-shaped dip cross the lower portion of the work.
